{{Quote|Perfect. I wonder if we'll get hit by a moon next.|Milinae Untaire, after biting into a gone off chewing root|<ref name="Standoffs">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/livingforce/swlf20041216|text=Standoffs}}</ref>}}
'''Chewing root''' was a type of edible root. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Milinae Untaire]] carried a stick of chewing root in her pocket while fighting against [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] and [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshans]] on a [[Space station/Legends|space station]] in the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]]. She discovered the root while looking for a [[Grenade/Legends|grenade]] and she bit into it. However, the root was gone off and it had a sour taste.
